dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Gradual, symmetrical 2D geometric narrowing from the mid-dorsal region toward the posterior peduncle.
dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.planar_edge_undulation: Primarily smooth lateral margins with minor pixel-level irregularities on the right flank where the surface meets the water interface.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: Mature white; median intensity is split by a longitudinal shadow on the left flank and high-intensity specular highlights on the right.

other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced longitudinal dorsal ridge extending from the mid-trunk to the tail fluke insertion point.
